title: Isolate exact Maker-GTD evidence from general market-data side effects
author: agent:/root

scope.goal: Remove the proven market-data side-effect backlog that causes exact ETH Reference Average Maker-GTD Paper orders to reach the existing evidence-unavailable expiry deadline, while preserving every accepted Maker evidence event and all approved trading, fill, accounting, Paper-only, and Live boundaries.
inScope: Separate exact Maker-GTD market-data evidence processing from the single general Paper side-effect worker so unrelated position-mark and ordinary-Paper work cannot delay Maker evidence.

Preserve every accepted authoritative pre-expiry Book, PriceChange, LastTrade, and BestBidAsk event required by each exact Maker order, with its original source timestamp, received timestamp, payload, fingerprint, per-asset FIFO ordering, publication fence, and expiry boundary; Maker evidence must not be dropped, coalesced, or reordered.

Let the general side-effect lane coalesce only replaceable quote updates after exact Maker order IDs have been safely extracted to the Maker lane and only when no remaining non-Maker open order requires that individual update; retain existing nonreplaceable handling for trades, resolutions, persistence-enabled events, unknown exposure, and ordinary Paper evidence.
Keep exact Maker fill evaluation and atomic persistence on the dedicated path, without per-event position-mark writes or unrelated settlement/ordinary-Paper processing in that path.

Make exact-order expiry drain and queue telemetry observe and prioritize the dedicated Maker lane while retaining the existing absolute preflight deadline and fail-closed maker_gtd_evidence_unavailable fallback for genuine unresolved work.

Add deterministic overload, ordering, race, publication, expiry-boundary, exception-isolation, and regression tests; document the queue split and position-mark timing tradeoff; run focused tests, full solution build, and independent semantic review.
Merge and push only the locally verified approved change through the current codex/reference-average-available-windows branch; production deployment and verification remain user-controlled.
outOfScope: Changing Reference Average signals, windows, thresholds, direction, selected outcome, entry timing, order price, stake, GTD/PostOnly intent, TouchNoDepth predicate, contract version, mandatory label, fee/PnL/settlement formulas, or dashboard calculations.
Dropping, sampling, coalescing, or reordering exact Maker evidence; replacing event-by-event evidence with a synthetic high/low, latest-only value, inferred touch, or post-expiry reconstruction.
Changing Live behavior, enabling Live Maker orders, extending the closed Paper exception to another strategy, asset, alias, clone, or execution semantic.
Changing database schema, production data, strategy/catalog configuration, WebSocket subscriptions, reconnect/stale policy, service hosting/startup, migrations, or general risk controls.

Replaying or rewriting existing terminal orders, fabricating fills for prior evidence-unavailable expirations, deploying/restarting production, or claiming recovery before a later read-only production verification.
scope.periodOrFilter: Exact closed-exception ETH neutral Reference Average Maker-GTD Paper family: 28 group-8223 strategies and existing maker_gtd_paper_v1/v2 orders. Read-only production evidence at cutoff 2026-08-23T06:11:02.191920Z: the last 100 exact-family timeout expirations in six hours had matching received-event age 82,156.7825..261,849.3178 ms and total pending queue 1,686..157,760; in-flight processing was generally milliseconds, proving queue wait rather than a single long-running handler call.
scope.firstVerification: Trace each accepted WebSocket event from MarketDataWebSocketService through MarketDataSideEffectQueue and PaperTradingMarketDataUpdater, verify which events are nonreplaceable when exact Maker IDs are attached, and prove that the configured per-asset maximum is a soft diagnostic threshold rather than a capacity limit before selecting the queue split.

requirements.text: Exact Maker-GTD evidence must use a dedicated processing path that preserves all accepted evidence and is not blocked by the general side-effect backlog.
acceptanceCriteria: Every accepted authoritative pre-expiry Maker event is assigned to the exact eligible Maker order IDs and retained until evaluated or until an explicitly recorded handler failure; no Maker event is dropped, coalesced, sampled, or reordered within its asset stream.

The Maker path carries the original event payload, source timestamp, received timestamp, fingerprint, asset/token identity, and publication fence needed by the existing evidence and atomic-fill rules.
A blocked or slow general Paper/position-mark handler does not prevent the dedicated Maker path from evaluating its accepted events or completing exact-order expiry drain.

The dedicated Maker handler performs only exact Maker evidence evaluation and the existing atomic fill attempt; it does not update position marks, settle unrelated positions, or process ordinary Paper orders.

The existing exact Maker signal, v1/v2 pricing, stake, PostOnly/GTD intent, TouchNoDepth predicate, first-valid-touch result, atomic exactly-once persistence, PaperOnly/Live-disabled boundary, and mandatory optimistic label remain byte-for-byte or behaviorally unchanged as applicable.

requirements.text: General market-data work may be reduced only after Maker evidence is safely separated, without changing ordinary-Paper evidence requirements or financial semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: After exact Maker IDs are routed to the Maker path, Book, PriceChange, and BestBidAsk work with no remaining non-Maker eligible order may follow the existing replaceable-update coalescing rule when event persistence is disabled.
LastTrade, resolution, persistence-enabled, handler-failure, unknown-exposure, and updates required by any remaining non-Maker open order retain their existing nonreplaceable behavior.

Position marks continue to receive current market prices through the general lane and the existing independent five-second position-mark worker; only redundant intermediate quote-triggered mark writes that existed solely because Maker IDs made updates nonreplaceable may be coalesced.
Ordinary Paper orders, copied-trader Paper, settlements, lifecycle outcomes, and dashboard accounting retain their existing functional behavior.
Queue metrics distinguish dedicated Maker pending/in-flight work from general pending/in-flight work and expiry timeout diagnostics identify the actual Maker phase and pending counts.

deviations.text: After exact Maker evidence has been retained on the dedicated path, allow otherwise replaceable general quote updates to coalesce even when the only open-order IDs originally attached to the event belonged to the exact Maker family.
deviations.impact: This removes the proven source of unbounded general queue growth without discarding any Maker evidence. It can reduce redundant intermediate per-event position-mark database writes; current marks still flow through the coalesced general update and the existing five-second position-mark worker. It must not alter fills, settlements, realized PnL, ordinary-Paper evidence, or Live behavior.
